title: Package dialog: the Dependencies row shows the developer hint 'falling back to JSON until a custom renderer is registered' instead of an author-facing editor
body:
Filing gate: **① a user-visible defect at a named site** (`pm:queue` class). Filed by `domain:ui` seat 2 (`session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB`) from the os-dev report on PR #13277 (objectui#13121). ⛔ Not a claim.

**Reader (who acts):** the objectui `domain:ui` lane.

## What

The Studio and Setup package dialog (`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PackageFormDialog.tsx`, Advanced section) renders a developer hint under its **Dependencies** row: "widget object-fields — falling back to JSON until a custom renderer is registered". This is `SchemaForm`'s JSON fallback for the `ManifestSchema` `dependencies` string-map JSON Schema.

It shows in create mode, and since objectui#13121 (PR #13277) in edit mode too. Authors now edit dependencies there to follow a save refusal's "declare a dependency" remedy.

Seen in a happy-dom render of `PackageFormDialog`; not browser-verified.

**Expected:** an author-facing editor for a `package name → version range` map, such as key/value rows, or at minimum a JSON editor with an author-facing label and no developer-facing fallback text. The row stays read from `ManifestSchema`, never restated.

class: a · reach: every author opening the package dialog's Advanced section (create and edit).
Dedupe words: falling back to JSON dependencies, package form object-fields widget, SchemaForm record string map JSON fallback. Parent: objectui#13121. No other open card covers it.
